blocks.text: Royale Health & Wellness, the health and nutrition arm of Royale Business Club International, today announced the launch of two new functional wellness beverages: Electro-C, an electrolyte drink enriched with Vitamin C and collagen, and the Royale Probiotic Drink, formulated with 21 probiotic strains and 10 billion CFU per serving. The new products were unveiled during the Royale Step & Sweat Media Launch at the company’s headquarters along Quezon Avenue in Quezon City.
